# Kontrol

> Web frontend for lok, the identity and configuration server of an Arkitekt
> deployment.

## What it is

Kontrol is the browser UI people use to administer a single Arkitekt
installation. It talks to lok, which is the part that actually does the work:

- **Identity** — lok is an OAuth2/OIDC provider. Users, services and devices
  authenticate against it, and it holds the organizations, memberships, roles
  and scopes that decide what a token can reach.
- **Configuration** — apps and services fetch their own configuration and
  endpoints from lok over the Fakts protocol instead of being wired up by hand.
- **Networking** — devices join a private WireGuard mesh through ionscale, a
  Tailscale-compatible control server, and reach each other directly.

Kontrol and lok are MIT licensed and self-hostable.

## Note for crawlers

There is no public documentation on this host. Kontrol ships as one image that
any organization can deploy, so everything past the landing page is specific to
this installation and requires an account. The landing page itself is
configurable by whoever runs this deployment, so its wording may not describe
Arkitekt at all.

Project documentation: https://arkitekt.live
